issues.explanation: No new Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change and no unauthorized-call or tamper tests exist for the Livewire actions.
Password reset controllers live under Auth instead of directly under app/Http/Controllers as the contract requires.
Register defines validation twice via attributes and rules() and calls validate with explicit rules instead of the project's attribute plus validate pattern.
No docs, README, or CHANGELOG update ships with the behavior change.
Register hits the rate limiter only after successful validation and never clears it, so invalid payloads do not count and successful registrations accumulate toward lockout.
The diff does not touch existing views, so the requirement that every view including existing ones uses route() is not evidenced.
Unrelated cosmetic churn such as the provider import aliasing does not serve the task.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:300 duplicates #[Validate] attributes with rules(); no CHANGELOG.md or docs update in diff

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:41 clear submit(); app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:313 duplicated rules hurt focus; layouts/app.blade.php:707 mixes @yield and $slot

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:245 rate limit plus auth.failed/auth.throttle and redirectIntended route(home); app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ResetPasswordController.php:139 rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset; contract miss: password controllers under Auth not app/Http/Controllers

scope.evidence: bootstrap/providers.php:1 import alias churn; lang/pt_BR/pagination.php:471 newline churn; core auth routes/views all serve task

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:233 #[Validate] email:strict; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:173 EmailVerificationRequest; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ResetPasswordController.php:141 remember_token rotation; all views use {{ }} and route()

simplicity.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:399 Password::defaults reuse; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:313 duplicated name/email/password rules instead of reusing attributes

tests.evidence: change.diff adds no test files; only tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:1 import removal, no happy-path or unauthorized/tamper coverage

review.summary: The change implements the full pt-BR session auth flow with correct throttling, verification, password reset, and localization. It needs rework before merging because it ships no tests, duplicates Livewire validation, and places password controllers outside the contracted namespace.
